title: A trial keeps the serve command output and can remove read-only scratch
description: Runs real merge trials of a fixture repository whose declared serve command prints 100 lines and either never answers or exits early. Each trial leaves all of the command's output in a file under the trial run directory, and the last 40 lines in the trial result with the time the command ran. The fixture's build leaves a read-only tree (directories 0555, files 0444) in the trial's scratch, which the trial removes whole and reports no leftover.

steps.name: a serve command that never answers or exits early keeps its output, and read-only scratch is removed
